Name: Silo Hay Capacity Modifier
Author: Gizzy91
Description:
A content pack that alllows for the hay capacity customisation of the Silo, providing a quality of life improvement where there's no need to build numerous silos, saving precious space on the farm!

The default value set is 240 (As if there is only 1 Silo on the farm).

This mod can be configured directly via the "config.json" file or via the Generic Mod Config Menu (The latter is advised)

Manifest.Name: Silo Hay Capacity Modifier
Manifest.Description: Allows for customisable Silo Hay capacity.
